notes: Declares Core's compatibility window against Specialists / xtmux / node.
Consumed by scripts/check-runtime-compatibility.mjs (build-time gate) and by cli/src/core/runtime-compat.ts (launch preflight) — hence shipped in package.json files.
NOT enforced at CLI startup — see NON_GOALS in xtrm-f2pey.2. Repair commands (xt update, xt doctor) must keep working on a drifted install.

Enforced at interactive worktree launch (xt claude / xt pi) since xtrm-7h5xh: an installed sibling whose version falls outside its range is rejected BEFORE the worktree is created. A sibling that is absent or unresolvable is never an incompatibility, and XTRM_SKIP_RUNTIME_COMPAT=1 overrides.
Bumping a minimum here should coincide with the release PR that requires it (see ~/dev/11.md P1-06 for the target flow).
